results.title: Hold on to Your Music - A Mother's Legacy
results.original_title: Hold on to Your Music - A Mother's Legacy
results.overview: Three generations of Jewish women bound by music and trauma navigate the legacy of the Holocaust, from Vienna to London to Los Angeles, in a quest for redemption.

results.title: The Devil's Lettuce: A Cursed 90s PSA
results.original_title: The Devil's Lettuce: A Cursed 90s PSA
results.overview: This drug awareness short follows Billy, a teenager who smokes weed for the first time and turns his night into a hellish nightmare.
A bankrupt director in need of money to make a dream movie is trying to find her Alzheimer's mother who has just disappeared after promising to sell a house and divide her assets.

results.title: Drinking and Driving
results.overview: Early twenties Iris and Palmer never left their hometown. They work at the same restaurant, share the same bed, and both have a habit of drinking and driving. They run into Levi, a guy they used to know. They spend time with him and his cousin, Phoenix, in cars, backyards, and other people’s bedrooms. When Levi shares a dream he had with Iris things change between the four of them. The reality of the summer becomes faded, the parties die. The four end in a field of unified confusion.

results.title: Christmas & Chaos
results.overview: Two musicians with clashing styles join forces to create music that will wow a powerful impresario and his associate. Their collaboration is key to keeping their show alive and thriving in a competitive industry.

results.title: Paths
results.overview: Blue lives alongside a small dog in a world with nothing but the two of them. Their lives are turned upside down when they discover a mysterious sign amidst the emptiness.

results.title: Through the Dust of Time
results.overview: Wugou Village faces cultural erasure as young people migrate away. The ancestral farmlands and grand "huofang" estates have become hollow monuments. Alan and her friend Amei remain within these quiet walls. Their daily exchanges capture the profound resilience and quiet fate of traditional Hakka women.

results.title: Where the Silver Fades
results.overview: The sands of Haeundae Beach seem like a landscape that has always been there. Yet the elders who grew up here remember a different sand, silver in color. That sand was replaced, and even the fact of its replacement was erased. Following British naval charts, colonial-era promotional leaflets, military aerial photographs, and contemporary tourist postcards, the film reveals that the place we now call Haeundae is a sediment of images selected by outside gazes.

results.title: Newcomer
results.overview: A 19th century séance opens a door to something far worse than the dead.

results.title: Convocação Geral da Categoria
results.overview: The film uses the events of April 2024 - when a meeting between teachers and their union descended into chaos and physical violence - as a starting point to reflect on the disagreements that have led to a breakdown in the relationship between educators and the bodies that represent them.

results.title: Pickpocket
results.overview: A pickpocket who has spent his life invisible spirals into paranoia when he suddenly feels exposed.

results.title: Poker Roulette
results.overview: Two men face each other across a poker table in a secret underground game where every losing hand means pulling the trigger. As the rounds unfold, a young newcomer and a seasoned veteran confront fear, chance, and the thin line between courage and recklessness, while a silent dealer oversees the game. With each turn, the stakes rise and survival becomes a matter of nerve as much as luck.  Shot on 16mm film, Poker Roulette is a silent short film about risk, fate, and the choices we make when there is no turning back.

results.title: Why I Am an Anarchist
results.overview: In the wealthy suburbs of Arizona, an animal-rights extremist has her ideology thrown into a tailspin when she meets an unhoused teenager in the desert behind her school.

results.title: K4OS 4Ever Tour
results.overview: K4OS arrives at the iconic Teatro Gran Rex with their "4EVER Tour" a show packed with energy, choreography, and vocal intensity, in which they perform their hit songs before a crowd of fans.

results.title: Erô
results.overview: The term "erô" refers to sacred knowledge within the context of Afro-Indigenous religions. "Erô" is also the nickname of Erodimar - a fierce and resiliente woman, a heroine of the hinterlands.

results.title: Zé do Caixão: Inferno em Sitges
results.original_title: Zé do Caixão: Inferno em Sitges
results.overview: The love story between José Mojica Marins and the Sitges Film Festival dates back to 1972, when, during its fifth edition, the Catalan Festival screened This Night I'll Possess Your Corpse. It was in 1978 that the Brazilian actor and director attended the Festival for the first time. He would return later in 1997 and 2008, by then firmly established as a key figure in the global horror film scene. This documentary chronicles Marins’ visits to the Festival through images and documents.

results.title: Calamity Wayne
results.overview: In 1960s Belfast, timid ten-year-old Wayne hopes to impress his crush, Annette. Named after Western star John Wayne, he must summon his own courage when a bully challenges him to a showdown at the local cinema.
